name: families
title: Diocese of Buffalo: Family of Parishes assignment masterlist (April 2026 issue)
command: pnpm diocese roster import buffalo families /tmp/bf/families-roster.json
notes: Built from the masterlist PDF: one entry per filled bullet (a canonical parish, kind 'parish') and per hollow bullet (a worship site of the parish above it). group is the family. The best source for canonical structure; lags on closures (it still carried St. Joseph, Lockport, closed in 2024). A family is not a bulletin.
